c117085469.notes: Hand-painted joinery workshop banner between two wooden posts, Tsinga, Yaoundé, 1974 slide (faded colour). Spellings as painted ('MODENE', 'DUTEMPS', 'INCRUTATION'; a gap after the first M of 'MENUISERIE'). The decorative letters make line 3 hard. Two smaller lines below are left out as unreliable: they read approximately 'BRASURE DES SCIES A RUBAN INSIGNES D' HABITS' and '450 M AU FOND DERNIER POTEAU ELECTRIQUE' / 'STYLE EXIGE'. A red arrow points right.

c133330834.notes: Red money-transfer shop fascia, Ndogbong, Douala, shot in dim light through a vehicle window. Line 3 starts behind a black banner (the hidden word probably 'Agence'); the last line is cut at the right edge ('fé[riés]'); a tiny registration number line at left is illegible. Alternative query: 'Emi Money'. The ADVANS board, the Emi money kiosk and the Ria sticker are distractors.
